title: The Price: Out of Sight

texts.details:
Close the door. You were not followed? Good.

You have noticed where I teach. Under an inn, behind the casks. Ask yourself why. Then bring me two soul shards, taken by your own hand, so that I know you understand what you are taking.

And there is a thing to be cleaned up. A student of mine bound a servant from the void and lost hold of it. It is loose in the woods south of the village. If the guard finds it before you do, they will come looking for whoever called it, and they will find all of us. Destroy it, $N.
texts.objectives: Bring 2 Soul Shards to your teacher and destroy the Unleashed Servant, which haunts the woods south of Goldshire. Then return.
texts.progress: The shards first. I will not teach one who flinches at the taking.
texts.completion:
Two shards, and the thing unmade. Then you have paid the smallest price there is, and seen what the first one buys.

Listen. Every power we hold was paid for by someone. The mages will tell you their art is a line of teachers. Ours is a line of debts. I pay mine in this cellar: I will die without anyone above these stairs knowing my name, and until a few years ago they would have burned me for it.

I am going to have you shown the rest of the bill. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, go over the sea to the goblin port of Ratchet. There is a tower on the hill, and a man in it named Strahad Farsan.

idea: The Price, level 10 (Alliance): bring soul shards and destroy a demon that slipped its master. From the wiki: warlocks were shunned and hunted until after the Third War and most still practise in hidden enclaves. Invented: the Unleashed Servant.
